title: Laredo PD hiring: police officer applications open November 30
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department says its police officer application window opens November 30 and runs through December 12, with the pre-agility exam January 9-10 and the written exam January 22, 2027.
content:
The Laredo Police Department is hiring police officers, and the application window opens November 30, 2026.

The department's recruitment team announced the dates on its JoinLaredoPD page on Monday, November 10. Applications will be accepted November 30 through December 12, 2026, online at www.JoinLaredoPD.com.

The pre-agility examination is scheduled for January 9-10, 2027, and the police written examination is set for January 22, 2027.

The starting academy salary is $56,992, and the starting base pay is $82,540, effective October 2027.

The physical agility test includes a 1.5-mile run in 15 minutes and 20 seconds, 29 push-ups in one minute, 31 sit-ups in one minute, and an obstacle course that includes a 6-foot wall climb and a 180-pound dummy drag.

The department is encouraging anyone interested to start preparing now, before the application window opens.

Source: Laredo Police Department recruitment page (JoinLaredoPD), November 10, 2026.
